question: Which of the following countries was elected to the Vice Presidency of the Internaonal Associaon of Marine Aids to Navigaon and Lighthouse Authories (IALA) in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Japan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **International Association of Marine Aids to Navigation and Lighthouse Authorities (IALA)** is a global organization focused on ensuring safe and efficient navigation for maritime vessels worldwide.
 
• **Japan** was elected to the Vice Presidency of IALA in **2025**, marking a significant achievement for the country in international maritime affairs.
 
• IALA works with member countries and organizations to develop and harmonize maritime navigation systems, including lighthouses and buoys, ensuring international standards are maintained.
 
• Japan’s election to the Vice Presidency highlights its active involvement in maritime safety and its commitment to fostering global cooperation in navigation technology.
 
• The Vice Presidency position is crucial for leading strategic initiatives and contributing expertise in maritime navigation systems globally.
